The '''Herkeath mine''' was a mine that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. It operated during the months following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
